items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 4:04 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Days of Significance
notes:
Mayor B. Vrbanovic, on behalf of City Council, acknowledged the 5-year anniversary of the attack on our London Family, the Seniors Month, National Indigenous History Month, Pride Month, the Kitchener Rangers and their 2026 Memorial Cup Championship.

Councillor S. Stretch left and re-entered the meeting at this time.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Planning and Strategic Initiatives Committee report - May 25, 2026
Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA26/003/K/AA, 450-470 King Street East, DSD-2026-184
notes:
Council considered Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA26/003/K/AA, 450-470 King Street East, DSD-2026-184, which was considered at the Planning and Strategic Initiatives Committee on Monday May 25, 2026. Council was also in receipt of written submissions from N. Tarswell, Q. Dupont and N. Budd. 
Arwa Alzoor, Planner, Katie Anderl, Project Manager of Planning, Tina Malone-Wright, Manager, Development Approvals and Garett Stevenson, Director, Development and Housing Approvals were in attendance to respond to questions from Council. Erfa Alani, Kitchener Housing Inc. (KHI), was also in attendance to respond to questions from Council.

Dr. Quinn DuPont addressed Council in opposition to the subject application, noting the neighbourhood would benefit from a park in this location. Dr. Q. Dupont expressed further concern about the logistics related to the ownership and approval of the subject application.

Justin Readman, General Manager, Development Services Department and Denise McGoldrick, General Manager, Infrastructure Services Department were also in attendance to respond to questions from Council.

items.title: Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
notes: Mayor B. Vrbanovic noted for information, that the Region of Waterloo, at a meeting later this week would be considering a report on a risk-based approach on water capacity and development.

motions.item_title: Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA26/003/K/AA, 450-470 King Street East, DSD-2026-184
motions.text: "That Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA26/003/K/AA for The Corporation of the City of Kitchener, for 450-470 King Street East, be APPROVED in the form shown in the ‘Proposed By-law’, and ‘Map No. 1’ attached to Development Services Department report, DSD-2026-184 as Attachments ‘A1’ and ‘A2’ and further; That the Urban Design Report, prepared by GSP Group Inc., dated May 2026, attached as Attachment ‘G’ to Development Services Department report, DSD-2026-184, be endorsed, and that staff be directed to implement the Urban Design Report through a future Site Plan Approval process."
